title: Earth's record-shortest-day deviation, milliseconds under 24 hours

source.name: Length-of-day measurements, International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service (IERS) / US Naval Observatory (USNO)

notes: Length-of-day deviation from the standard 86,400-second day, in milliseconds SHORTER, on Earth's record-setting fastest-rotation days as tracked by IERS/USNO atomic-clock measurements: July 19 2020 (-1.47ms, a new record at the time), June 29 2022 (-1.59ms, broke it), July 5 2024 (-1.66ms, current record). Since 2020, Earth has been spinning faster than at any point since precision rotation measurement began.
